annotations.text:
Calm and premium.

Instrument Serif for headings, IBM Plex Sans for everything else. Warm off-white ground, deep green accent used sparingly — one action per screen carries it.

A deliberate break from the current dark theme.

Upload is visually primary because it is the fastest route to a finished profile — but the questions path is a full card, not a small link, since it is the differentiator and shouldn't read as a fallback.
